blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Sen. Robinhood Padilla hinted Wednesday that his days in the Senate my be numbered as he faces an obstruction of justice complaint over allegations that he helped Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa leave the Senate compound in May. Padilla mentioned the complaint against him during the 29th day of the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. “Kaya po namin nababangit ang mga kasama namin sa minorya na kasalukuyan ay nasa piitan sapagkat malinaw naman po na baka ito na rin ang huli ko ditong araw e.
